WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT decision_id row_key, date row_date, ((length(CAST(json_quote(decision_id) AS BLOB))+15)+(length(CAST(json_quote(date) AS BLOB))+8)+(length(CAST(json_quote(symbol) AS BLOB))+10)+(length(CAST(json_quote(name) AS BLOB))+8)+(length(CAST(json_quote(strategy_id) AS BLOB))+15)+(length(CAST(json_quote(strategy_version) AS BLOB))+20)+(length(CAST(json_quote(strategy_status) AS BLOB))+19)+(length(CAST(json_quote(alpha_bucket) AS BLOB))+16)+(length(CAST(json_quote(matched) AS BLOB))+11)+(length(CAST(json_quote(match_score) AS BLOB))+15)+(length(CAST(json_quote(reason_code) AS BLOB))+15)+(length(CAST(json_quote(context_json) AS BLOB))+16)+(length(CAST(json_quote(evidence_json) AS BLOB))+17)+(length(CAST(json_quote(created_at) AS BLOB))+14)+64) row_bytes
        FROM strategy_decision_log
       WHERE date IS NOT NULL AND date<?
         AND (strategy_decision_log.context_id IS NOT NULL
         AND strategy_decision_log.evidence_artifact_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((
      LENGTH(COALESCE(context_json, '')) > ?
      AND COALESCE(context_json, '') NOT LIKE '%"archived_to_r2":true%'
    ) OR (
      LENGTH(COALESCE(evidence_json, '')) > ?
      AND COALESCE(evidence_json, '') NOT LIKE '%"archived_to_r2":true%'
    )) 
       ORDER BY date,decision_id LIMIT ?
    ), budgeted AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT *,SUM(row_bytes) OVER (ORDER BY row_date,row_key) total_bytes FROM candidates
    ) SELECT strategy_decision_log.decision_id,strategy_decision_log.date,strategy_decision_log.symbol,strategy_decision_log.name,strategy_decision_log.strategy_id,strategy_decision_log.strategy_version,strategy_decision_log.strategy_status,strategy_decision_log.alpha_bucket,strategy_decision_log.matched,strategy_decision_log.match_score,strategy_decision_log.reason_code,strategy_decision_log.context_json,strategy_decision_log.evidence_json,strategy_decision_log.created_at,
        (LENGTH(COALESCE(context_json, '')) + LENGTH(COALESCE(evidence_json, ''))) __blob_bytes
      FROM strategy_decision_log JOIN budgeted b ON b.row_key=strategy_decision_log.decision_id
      WHERE b.total_bytes<=1048576 ORDER BY strategy_decision_log.date,strategy_decision_log.decision_id

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT id row_key, date row_date, ((length(CAST(json_quote(id) AS BLOB))+6)+(length(CAST(json_quote(run_id) AS BLOB))+10)+(length(CAST(json_quote(date) AS BLOB))+8)+(length(CAST(json_quote(symbol) AS BLOB))+10)+(length(CAST(json_quote(name) AS BLOB))+8)+(length(CAST(json_quote(stage) AS BLOB))+9)+(length(CAST(json_quote(decision) AS BLOB))+12)+(length(CAST(json_quote(reason_code) AS BLOB))+15)+(length(CAST(json_quote(score_before) AS BLOB))+16)+(length(CAST(json_quote(score_after) AS BLOB))+15)+(length(CAST(json_quote(rank) AS BLOB))+8)+(length(CAST(json_quote(evidence) AS BLOB))+12)+(length(CAST(json_quote(created_at) AS BLOB))+14)+64) row_bytes
        FROM screener_funnel_items
       WHERE date IS NOT NULL AND date<?
         AND (NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM canonical_run_heads h
            WHERE h.run_id = screener_funnel_items.run_id
         )
         AND screener_funnel_items.run_id <> COALESCE((
           SELECT latest.run_id
             FROM screener_funnel_runs latest
            WHERE latest.date = screener_funnel_items.date
              AND latest.status = 'success'
            ORDER BY latest.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
         ), '')) AND ((
      LENGTH(COALESCE(evidence, '')) > ?
      AND COALESCE(evidence, '') NOT LIKE '%"archived_to_r2":true%'
    )) 
       ORDER BY date,id LIMIT ?
    ), budgeted AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT *,SUM(row_bytes) OVER (ORDER BY row_date,row_key) total_bytes FROM candidates
    ) SELECT screener_funnel_items.id,screener_funnel_items.run_id,screener_funnel_items.date,screener_funnel_items.symbol,screener_funnel_items.name,screener_funnel_items.stage,screener_funnel_items.decision,screener_funnel_items.reason_code,screener_funnel_items.score_before,screener_funnel_items.score_after,screener_funnel_items.rank,screener_funnel_items.evidence,screener_funnel_items.created_at,
        (LENGTH(COALESCE(evidence, ''))) __blob_bytes
      FROM screener_funnel_items JOIN budgeted b ON b.row_key=screener_funnel_items.id
      WHERE b.total_bytes<=1048576 ORDER BY screener_funnel_items.date,screener_funnel_items.id
